description: Use this when the customer asks whether their transfer request was confirmed, assigned or cancelled. Requires the booking reference returned by create_transfer_request and the email used for the request. Read-only. pending means the operator has not confirmed yet; only operatorConfirmed=true means the ride is confirmed. Do not use to create or change a request.

customerEmail.description: Email address used when the request was submitted

name: get_request_status
title: Check transfer request status
